# Meter

> Pay-per-thought AI for builders. Every frontier model, one bill, no subscription.

Meter is a pay-per-thought AI platform that routes across frontier models (GPT, Claude, Gemini, and more), runs structured multi-model debates, logs decisions as durable records, and commits an Agent Spec Kit to GitHub so coding agents start with perfect context.

## Core Features

- **Multi-model routing**: Access every frontier AI model through a single interface. The meter runs in dollars — pay only for what you think.
- **Debate mode**: Force models into explicit positions, require them to critique each other's strongest arguments, and produce a final synthesis with trade-offs and a recommended decision.
- **Decision records**: Structured decision logs (not raw chat transcripts) with context, choice, and trade-offs — stored as first-class objects.
- **Agent Spec Kit**: Deterministic markdown artifacts (README.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, DESIGN.md, DECISIONS.md, .cursorrules, CLAUDE.md) committed to GitHub so coding agents start with perfect context.
- **Connectors**: Planner mode (Gmail/Linear/Calendar), Coder mode (GitHub/Vercel/Porkbun), Banker mode (Stripe/Mercury/Puzzle/Gusto).

## API

Meter provides a versioned REST API at /api/v1/ for programmatic access:

- POST /api/v1/chat — Send messages to AI models
- GET /api/v1/sessions — List chat sessions
- GET /api/v1/history — Get usage history
- GET /api/v1/billing/status — Check billing status
- POST /api/v1/billing/setup — Set up billing

Authentication is via passkeys (WebAuthn) with session-based auth for the API.

## Authentication

Meter uses passkey-based authentication (WebAuthn/FIDO2). No passwords. Sign up with your device biometrics or security key.

## Billing

Pay-per-use billing via Stripe. Add a card, use any model, get billed for actual token usage with a transparent markup. No subscriptions, no tiers.
